what_it_is.prose: ISRO lists nine LVM3 missions and reports a July 2026 CE20 flight-acceptance test at 22-tonne thrust. The LVM3 programme has supported Chandrayaan missions, OneWeb commercial launches and BlueBird Block-2. ISRO also states that human-rating qualification requirements for the CE20 engine were accomplished for the Gaganyaan path. The dossier treats LVM3 as an operational Indian heavy launcher and keeps future mission schedules separate from completed flights.
